title: Revisiting Continual Learning in Language Models: A Three-Interface Diagnosis of Stability and Plasticity
abstract: arXiv:2611.30151v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continual learning in language models is commonly studied in the incremental learning (IL) setting, where a model learns a sequence of tasks and is evaluated through its final classifier or language-model (LM) head. This interface, however, does not indicate where forgetting occurs: a drop in accuracy may reflect representation degradation in the backbone, readout mismatch in the head, or both. We therefore argue that backward transfer (BWT) and forward transfer (FWT) should be interpreted as interface-dependent quantities rather than as single modellevel properties. We study three evaluation interfaces: the trained head, which is updated sequentially with the backbone; a probe newly trained on frozen backbone features; and a classifier-free backbone diagnostic. They measure deployed performance, recoverability under a new readout, and representation separability, respectively. Across class-incremental experiments with encoder and deco

translated_title: 重新审视语言模型中的持续学习：稳定性与可塑性的三接口诊断
translated_abstract: 语言模型中的持续学习通常在增量学习（IL）设置下进行研究，即模型学习一系列任务，并通过其最终的分类器或语言模型（LM）头进行评估。然而，这一接口无法揭示遗忘发生在何处：准确率的下降可能反映主干网络中的表征退化、读出头中的失配，或两者兼有。因此，我们认为后向迁移（BWT）和前向迁移（FWT）应被解释为依赖于接口的量，而非单一的模型级属性。我们研究了三种评估接口：与主干一起按顺序更新的已训练头部；在冻结的主干特征上新训练的探针；以及无分类器的主干诊断。它们分别衡量部署性能、在新读出下的可恢复性，以及表征可分性。在针对编码器和解码器模型的类增量实验中……
tldr: 该论文提出应通过已训练头部、冻结特征探针和无分类器主干诊断这三种评估接口来定位持续学习遗忘的发生位置（主干表征退化还是读出头失配），并主张BWT与FWT是依赖于接口的量而非单一的模型级属性。
en_tdlr: The paper argues that forgetting in continual learning should be diagnosed through three evaluation interfaces—the trained head, a frozen-feature probe, and a classifier-free backbone diagnostic—showing that backward and forward transfer are interface-dependent quantities rather than single model-level properties.
